scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:gssm"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd .. && cd gssm-server && npm install && cd .. && pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m core.features.integrations.monday.provision --import monday-app.json
scripts.clean: rm -rf frontend/dist && find . -type d -name '__pycache__' -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -type d -name '.pytest_cache' -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -type f -name '*.pyc' -delete && find . -type f -name '*.pyo' -delete && find . -type f -name '.DS_Store' -delete
scripts.verify: npm --prefix frontend run build && python3 -m py_compile deal_tracker.py core/app_factory.py core/features/deals/deals.py core/features/documents/documents.py core/features/settings/settings.py core/shared/state.py core/shared/defaults.py core/shared/security.py
